summary: OpenRig publishes no benchmark results; its release notes repeatedly disclaim latency, accuracy and reliability claims ('These changes reduce measured work; they do not establish a latency guarantee'). The only numbers are unsupported release-note figures (rig whoami ~909 -> ~192 tokens, ~79,000/~64,000-token payloads retired, ~2 GB RSS per seat, 0-2 s loading on a VM), and the one eval harness (live-model context-selection evals in packages/test-system/evals) is manual-only with no committed results. The 29%/84%/54% figures in skills/_canonical/process/context-engineering/SKILL.md are quoted third-party results (Anthropic, Manus, LangChain), not claims about OpenRig.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
